problem_statement: When a thread triggers an asynchronous connection with a non-blocking socket and then monitors that socket with poll() using only POLLIN, a failed connection is never reported: the thread stays blocked in poll() until the timeout expires and never learns that the connection was refused. An application that is not also watching POLLOUT cannot detect that the connect failed and remains stuck on a dead socket. poll() should return promptly with a POLLERR condition as soon as the connection fails, regardless of whether POLLOUT is monitored.
twister_command: scripts/twister -p native_sim/native/64 -T tests/net/socket/tcp -s tests/net/socket/tcp/net.socket.tcp -s net.socket.tcp -O twister-out --no-clean -W
